transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

I can’t shake this feeling that I’m useless now and just letting everyone down since my fall. I had an unexpected knee procedure a few weeks ago that has really limited my mobility, and I just feel like a burden to everyone who used to count on me.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in most activities you used to enjoy, even things that used to make you happy?

Yes, I really have. I just don't care about the things that used to light me up anymore, like my financial workshops, hiking with the seniors, or even tending to my tomato plants. When I look at the flyers or my gardening tools, I feel nothing but a blank indifference, so I end up just sitting in front of the TV instead of returning anyone's calls.
Have these feelings of worthlessness and loss of interest been present most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks?

Yes, it's been a constant, daily cloud over me for about a month now, ever since I realized my knee recovery was stalling. I wake up with this heavy feeling and it just drags on all day, making me feel so incredibly useless. It's just a steady, daily reminder of how much I'm failing everyone.

The symptoms are not limited to a stressor-related reaction and have evolved into a sustained depressive syndrome, supporting F32 (depressive episode) as the primary candidate. No evidence suggests an anxiety or mixed anxiety-depressive presentation, ruling out F43.2 as a leading diagnosis.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient presents with a major depressive episode characterized by persistent feelings of worthlessness, loss of interest in almost all activities, and a depressed mood lasting for more than one month, in the absence of manic or hypomanic episodes. Symptoms cause significant functional impairment and are not better explained by an adjustment disorder with depressed mood, given the severity and duration consistent with moderate to severe depression.
